Title: Azure Machine Learning offers free-usage tier

Body.Content: Now it is easier than ever for anyone to try Azure Machine Learning (Azure ML) because the service is available to test free of charge without an Azure subscription or credit card. All you need to get started is a Microsoft account ID. This free tier is another way that Azure ML is making advanced analytics accessible to more people. Database administrators, developers, business intelligence professionals, and nascent data scientists can now experiment with Azure ML at no cost. The Azure ML free tier is intended to provide an in-depth introduction to the Azure Machine Learning Studio. The free tier includes access to one Azure Machine Learning Studio workspace per Microsoft account, and it includes the ability to upload up to 10 GB of data sets and the ability to operationalize models as staging APIs. Note: Free-tier workloads are not covered by an SLA. Try it free today. Simply sign in to the Azure Machine Learning page with your Microsoft account.
